units.source: DealsService.StartAsync — Deal stored with VersionFor = null (one deal = one cart line or one listing-page request)
POST /{slug}/listings/create (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — ListingCreated in a StreamAction.Start; one listing = one started stream; app = the stream tenant
POST /{slug}/listings/{id}/offers (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — OfferSubmitted in a StreamAction.Start; one offer = one started stream; app = the stream tenant

POST /{slug}/support/open and POST /{slug}/listings/{id}/report (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — TicketCreated in a StreamAction.Start; a count of opened tickets, not support minutes; app = the stream tenant
PlanSubscribeService.SubscribeAsync — SubscriptionCreated in a StreamAction.Start (a member granted a store plan); app = the stream tenant

POST /admin/tenants/create, the studio create door (StudioTierService.RecordStoreBuiltAsync), the agent's create tool and the boot seeders — Tenant in Inserts; app = Tenant.Id; entrepreneur = Tenant.OwnerUserId
StudioAuth.VerifyAsync — StudioUser stored with VersionFor = null (an entrepreneur's first sign-in to the studio); app = _platform; entrepreneur = the account
AuthHandlers.GetOrCreateUserAsync — User stored with VersionFor = null (a member's first sign-in to a store); app = the session tenant; source = a pseudonym of User.Id
ReviewsService.SubmitAsync — Review in Inserts; app = the session tenant; source = the review id

POST /{slug}/chats/{conversationId}/send (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) and the sample conversations of the test and appearance seeders — Message in Inserts (one message = one send); app = the session tenant; source = the message id

TwilioSmsChannel.SendOtpAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when Twilio answers 2xx; request id = the attempt id (store door, AuthHandlers.RequestPhoneOtpHandler) or a fresh call id (studio door StudioAuth.SendPhoneCodeAsync, contact codes AccountContacts); app = the store slug or _platform

TwilioSmsChannel.SendNoticeAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when Twilio answers 2xx; request id = the notification id written before the send (AccountContacts.NoticeLinkedAsync); app = the store slug

BrevoEmailChannel.SendOtpAsync through ProviderHttp (one entry when Brevo answers 2xx) or SmtpEmailChannel.SendOtpAsync through ProviderCalls.InvokeAsync (one entry when MailKit SendAsync returned); request id = the attempt id (store door, AuthHandlers.RequestEmailOtpHandler) or a fresh call id (studio door StudioAuth.SendEmailCodeAsync, contact codes AccountContacts); app = the store slug or _platform

BrevoEmailChannel.SendNoticeAsync through ProviderHttp or SmtpEmailChannel.SendNoticeAsync through ProviderCalls.InvokeAsync — one entry when accepted; request id = the notification id written before the send (AccountContacts.NoticeLinkedAsync, DealNotices.MailStoreOwnerAsync); app = the store slug

NafathChannel.StartAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when Nafath answers the MFA request 2xx; request id = a fresh call id (the attempt id is Nafath's answer, known only after); app = the store slug (AuthHandlers.RequestNafathHandler); the OAuth token and the status poll are helpers, not counted

S3FileStorage.UploadAsync — PutObjectAsync inside ProviderCalls.InvokeAsync; one entry per accepted put, quantity = the bytes put; request id = a fresh call id (a re-upload is a new upload); source = a pseudonym of the object key (the avatar key carries a user id); app = the store slug (POST /{slug}/me/save, POST /{slug}/listings/create); reads, existence checks and deletes are helpers, not counted

WebPushService.SendAsync — SendNotificationAsync inside ProviderCalls.InvokeAsync, one entry per subscription the push service accepted; request id = {notificationId}:{pseudonym of the endpoint} (the notification written before the push); app = the store slug

GatewayPayments.OpenInvoiceAsync — the store gateway client's CreateInvoiceAsync through ProviderHttp; one entry when the POST /invoices answers 2xx (the metadata PUT that follows is a helper, not counted); request id = a fresh call id (the gateway takes no idempotency key, so a retried create is a second invoice); source = the first deal of the invoice; app = the store slug

the store gateway client's FetchInvoiceAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry per accepted GET; request id = {invoiceId}:verify:{fresh call id} (GatewayPayments.VerifyAsync), {invoiceId}:notice:{payment id} (ConfirmNoticeAsync), {invoiceId}:expiry (ExpireAsync — dedupes the scheduled retries) or {invoiceId}:close:{cancelled deal id} (GatewayInvoiceCloser, on every cancel of a deal with an invoice); source = the invoice id; app = the store slug

the store gateway client's CancelInvoiceAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when PUT /invoices/:id/cancel answers 2xx; request id = {invoiceId}:close (GatewayInvoiceCloser, after the last open deal of the invoice is cancelled); source = the invoice id; app = the store slug

the store gateway client's CreateWebhookAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when POST /webhooks answers 2xx; request id = a fresh call id (GatewayPayments.ConnectNoticesAsync, after the payments binding is written); app = the store slug

PayPalPaymentProvider.CreateBillingPlanAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when POST /v1/billing/plans answers 2xx; request id = the PayPal-Request-Id the kit sends (derived from the catalog product and the draft); the catalog product call before it and the OAuth token are helpers, not counted; app = _platform (POST /admin/tenants/{slug}/plan/paypal-plan binds a platform plan)

PayPalPaymentProvider.CreateSubscriptionAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when POST /v1/billing/subscriptions answers 2xx; request id = the PayPal-Request-Id (PayPalSurface.LinkKey); app = the store slug (POST /admin/tenants/{slug}/plan/paypal-link)

PayPalPaymentProvider.CreateOrderAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when POST /v2/checkout/orders answers 2xx; request id = the PayPal-Request-Id (PayPalOrderPolicy.OrderRequestId); app = the store slug (POST /admin/tenants/{slug}/plan/paypal-order)

PayPalPaymentProvider.CaptureOrderAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when the capture answers 2xx; request id = the PayPal-Request-Id (PayPalOrderPolicy.CaptureRequestId); app = the order's store (PayPalOrderFlow.CaptureAsync, from the capture button or the approval event)

PayPalPaymentProvider.VerifyWebhookSignatureAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when verify-webhook-signature answers 2xx, before the event is read; request id = the transmission id PayPal sent; app = _platform (POST /api/billing/paypal)

PaddlePaymentProvider.CreateTransactionAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when POST /transactions answers 2xx; request id = our reference (PaddleTransactionPolicy.Reference); app = the store slug (POST /admin/tenants/{slug}/plan/paddle-link)
